title.purpose: Section h2s on legal and info pages.

body.purpose: Form inputs and the nav drawer's links.

prose.purpose: Long-form legal text in a 42rem column.

label.purpose: 11px tracked uppercase: field labels, the solid button, eyebrows.

mono-label.purpose: Product facts: product name, price, notices, the pre-drop h1.

wordmark.purpose: Reserved for the wordmark and email headings; the site logo itself is SVG.

motion.value: 150ms ease-out (color, background-color, border-color, opacity); 1px translateY on :active under no-preference

motion.name: underline-sweep
motion.purpose: Link hover/focus hairline drawing in from the left.

motion.name: page-crossfade
motion.purpose: Cross-document view transition between pages and locales.

motion.name: cart-bump

components.name: Solid Button
components.description: Full-width ink block for every submit and buy action; inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-solid { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); background: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); color: var(--color-paper, #fafafa); padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, opacity 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-solid:hover { background: var(--color-paper, #fafafa); color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); } .ds-btn-solid:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-solid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-ink, #3a5fd9); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-solid:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Bare tracked uppercase label used inside the product band.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-text:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-btn-text:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-ink, #3a5fd9); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Underlined Field
components.description: Label above a boxless field with a single ink underline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: var(--color-mute, #63696e); } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); background: transparent; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); border-radius: 0; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-ink, #3a5fd9); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Size Row
components.description: Seven identical unboxed size cells; ink fill when selected; sold out is struck through.
components.css: .ds-sizes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); column-gap: 2px; max-width: 20rem; } .ds-size { min-height: 44px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-size:hover, .ds-size[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); color: var(--color-paper, #fafafa); } .ds-size:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-ink, #3a5fd9); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-size:disabled { color: var(--color-mute, #63696e); text-decoration: line-through; cursor: not-allowed; background: transparent; }

components.name: Fit Tabs
components.description: Two paper cells separated by hairline gaps; selected is ink.
components.css: .ds-fits { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1px; background: var(--color-line, #dcdcdc); max-width: 13rem; } .ds-fit { border: 0; background: var(--color-paper, #fafafa); color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); padding: 8px; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-fit:hover, .ds-fit[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); color: var(--color-paper, #fafafa); } .ds-fit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-ink, #3a5fd9); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Consent Checkbox
components.description: 16px square ink-bordered box; the whole label is the target; never pre-checked.
components.css: .ds-check { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; cursor: pointer; color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); } .ds-check input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-check-box { margin-top: 4px; width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); background: var(--color-paper, #fafafa); transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-check:hover .ds-check-box { border-color: var(--color-accent-ink, #3a5fd9); } .ds-check input:checked + .ds-check-box { background: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); } .ds-check input:focus-visible + .ds-check-box { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-ink, #3a5fd9); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Sweep Link
components.description: Footer and nav link whose 1px hairline draws in from the left on hover and focus.
components.html: RetoursLivraisonConfidentialité
components.css: .ds-footer { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 24px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-mute, #63696e); } .ds-sweep { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; background-image: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: 0 100%; background-size: 0 1px; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-size 250ms ease-out; } .ds-sweep:hover, .ds-sweep:focus-visible { background-size: 100% 1px; color: var(--color-accent-ink, #3a5fd9); } .ds-sweep:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-ink, #3a5fd9); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
A ruled page of ink on paper, held under a moving grey cloud deck. The sky is the only atmosphere on the site: a WebGL overcast field behind everything, greyscale, with clear sky as near-white and density reading darker. Everything in front of it is flat and exact: hairline rules instead of cards, square corners everywhere, small uppercase labels tracked wide, and one blue accent held back for links and focus.

Density is low and deliberate. The pre-drop home page is three lines in one `<h1>`, centred over the sky, and nothing else: what's dropping, what the brand is, when. When commerce is on, the product body is a single column of photograph, fit tabs, size row and one solid button. Type is small and the page is mostly air; the scale contrast comes from the sky and the photography, not from big headings.

The system is French-first and light-only. There is no dark mode on the site; the only dark surface in the brand is commercial email, which is always-dark on purpose (see Colors).
keyCharacteristics: Ink/paper monochrome with a single blue accent.
Hairlines (`line`) as the structural device; no cards, no shadows.
Zero radii, with exactly two circular exceptions.
11px uppercase labels at 0.18em tracking as the system's voice.
Hard 2px offset focus outline, never a soft ring.
Motion is short, eased, and fully gated on `prefers-reduced-motion`.
The cloud sky as the only texture, with a drawn static fallback.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only hue on the site. Everything that isn't a link, a focus state or the sky is ink, paper or grey.

rules.name: The Measured Pair Rule
rules.body: A colour that carries words has a contrast ratio written next to its declaration. A brand colour that fails AA gets a darkened sibling for text (`mute` for the logo grey, `accent-ink` for `accent`); the original stays on non-text uses.

rules.name: The Three Grounds Rule
rules.body: The same brand renders on three grounds, each with its own palette, and they are not interchangeable: the site is ink on paper (`global.css`); email is always-dark, light ink on #161616 with a lifted accent #8fa8ff (`EMAIL_THEME`, `src/lib/email.ts`), because mail clients auto-invert light mail; print is ink on unpainted white (`PRINT_THEME`, `shopify/src/print/theme.ts`), because paper has no inverting client and a dark sheet is just toner. The print lint fails on any `EMAIL_THEME` hex.

rules.name: The Small Voice Rule
rules.body: Headlines stay small. The pre-drop home page's `h1` is 0.75rem monospace; nothing on the commerce surface is set larger than the legal pages' 1.875rem. Scale comes from the sky and the photograph.

rules.name: The Label Tracking Rule
rules.body: Uppercase text is always tracked at `--tracking-label` (0.18em). Uppercase without tracking, or tracking at any other value, is drift (the PIN-style mono input at 0.25em is the one deliberate exception).

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation is a hairline, a fill change, or blur. Never a drop shadow, never a glow; the sky washes soft edges out.

rules.name: The Sky Is Weather, Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: The sky may degrade or stop, but it never leaves a white page. Its static fallback (`sky-fallback`) is a drawn overcast deck whose densest tone tracks the shader's `CLOUD_MIN`, and it is the whole background for reduced-motion, forced-colors and no-WebGL2 visitors. `prefers-contrast: more` flattens it to plain paper.

rules.name: The Two Circles Rule
rules.body: Exactly two things are round: the product carousel's pagination dots, and the cart link's confirmation ring. Both are circles or they are nothing. Each carries a `guard-allow-rounded` marker on its line, and `scripts/check-guards.sh` fails the build on any other `rounded-*` utility or non-zero `border-radius` in `src/`. A third circle is a design decision written next to its declaration, never a workaround.

rules.name: The Hard Edge Rule
rules.body: Focus is a 2px solid `accent-ink` outline at a 4px offset (`focus-block`), applied to native `:focus-visible` and to React Aria's `data-[focus-visible]`. Never a ring, glow or box-shadow.

dos: **Do** take colour from the eight `@theme` tokens in `global.css`; the shadcn semantic names (`--color-primary` etc.) are aliases onto them, not a second palette.
**Do** use `press` for controls and `underline-sweep` for links, and never combine either with `transition-colors`; they all set `transition-property` and one silently wins.
**Do** gate anything that moves with `motion-safe:` or a `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` block. Colour easing may stay.
**Do** set uppercase text at the 0.18em label tracking.
**Do** give every custom indicator an explicit forced-colors rendering.
**Do** keep every text colour at AA on paper and write the ratio beside any new text token.
donts: **Don't** add a radius. Two circles exist; a third needs a written reason and a `guard-allow-rounded` marker.
**Don't** add shadows, glows, or soft focus rings.
**Don't** add a dark mode to the site. Email is dark; the site is not.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue or a gradient on text or controls.
**Don't** use `motion-reduce:transition-none` to handle reduced motion; it leaves the element jumping to its end state.
**Don't** ship a webfont. Every stack is system or locally installed.
**Don't** put photography on the public pre-drop page.
